text: Join Class Live now!
Come and join in, everyone!
Grab your device and join the game!
Here we go! If we know this fact, what else do we know?
Star Web is on! How many facts can we find from this one?
Off we go! Use this fact to find lots more.
Here we go! Work along the chain and wake the serpent!
The serpent is sleeping. Work along the chain to wake it!
Off we go! Climb the serpent one sum at a time.
Here we go! Answer questions to flip the tiles!
A mystery picture is hiding. Answer questions to flip the tiles!
Off we go! Every right answer flips a tile.
An arm of the star web is lit!
Another arm lights up!
Look, a new arm is glowing!
Look! The sky creature is here!
Every arm is lit! Here comes the sky creature!
Wow! The sky creature has arrived!
Supernova! What a lot of facts!
Supernova! The whole sky is shining!
Boom! A supernova of facts!
The serpent is waking up!
Wake up, serpent! It is opening its eyes!
Rumble! The serpent is awake!
Someone reached the head of the serpent!
We made it to the head of the serpent!
All the way to the head! Brilliant!
Guessing is open! What could it be?
You can guess now! What is the picture?
Time to guess! What do you think it is?
Someone has guessed the picture!
A good guess! Someone got it!
We have a right guess!
Here's the picture!
Ta-da! Here it is!
Let's see the whole picture!
Time's up! Well done, everyone!
That's time! Great work, everyone!
Time's up! What a team!
Everyone reached the head! Amazing!
The whole class made it to the head!
All the way to the top, everyone! Brilliant!
Well done, everyone!
Great work, everyone!
What a team! Well done!
We know one times fact.
Use it to work out new facts. Turn it round, double, halve, times by ten, or add one more group.
Send your fact. Each new one becomes a star on the big screen.
Light up every arm of the web to bring out the sky creature!
Start at the stone. Do each sum along the serpent, one box at a time.
Write each answer on your device. You get two tries.
Every right answer moves your gem up the serpent.
Right answers from the whole class wake the serpent. Reach the head, then keep going on the bonus tail!
Today it is the sprout serpent: adding and taking away small numbers.
Today it is the leaf serpent: adding and taking away, numbers up to one hundred.
Today it is the green serpent: adding and taking away.
Today it is the jade serpent: adding and taking away, with times and share by two and ten.
Today it is the gold serpent: all four, with times and share by two, five and ten.
Today it is the amber serpent: all four, with times and share by two, three, four, five and ten.
Today it is the ruby serpent: all four, with times tables up to six, and numbers up to one thousand.
Today it is the fire serpent: all four, with times tables up to twelve.
A mystery picture is hiding under the tiles.
Answer maths questions on your device. Each right answer earns a flip.
Pick a tile to flip and show a little more of the picture.
When guessing opens, guess what the picture is!
Here is a clue. I'm bigger than any dinosaur, yet my dinner is smaller than your fingernail.
Here is a clue. I have a mouth but never eat. When I lose my temper, the whole island feels the heat.
Here is a clue. I wear a crown of stone teeth, and water hugs my feet to keep strangers out.
Here is a clue. I count backwards before I leave, and I go out through the roof of the sky.
Here is a clue. I share my name with a fruit and a whole nation, but I can never fly to visit either.
Here is a clue. My breath could light your birthday candles, but you'll only meet me in a story.
Here is a clue. I stand alone all night and wink at ships so they never bump the rocks.
Here is a clue. Three hearts, blue blood, and more arms than I could ever need for a hug.
Here is a clue. A home with no ground floor, where the neighbours are birds and the walls grow leaves.
Here is a clue. I fly bones on my flag, and my crew says "arr" instead of hello.
Here is a clue. I never forget, I carry my own hose, and I wear my ears like giant fans.
Here is a clue. I wear a suit to every party, I can't fly, but I'm a champion at sliding on my tummy.
Here is a clue. I can lick my own ears and I eat my lunch from the top of the tree. My scarf would need to be very long.
Here is a clue. I'm the king, but my crown is made of hair, and my wife does most of the hunting.
Here is a clue. I'm a bear in black and white, and I spend half my day chewing a very tough salad.
Here is a clue. My big teeth are scary but my tiny arms can't reach my nose. You'll only find my bones today.
Here is a clue. I'm a horse with a party hat that never comes off, and nobody has ever taken my photo.
Here is a clue. I never get tired and never eat lunch, but if you pull my plug, I'll take a very long nap.
Here is a clue. I go up when I get hot under my collar, and my passengers ride in a basket.
Here is a clue. I huff and I puff along my two long lines, and I always stop at the station to let people in.
Here is a clue. I'm a boat that likes to hide, and I peek above the waves with one long eye.
Here is a clue. My hat spins so fast it lifts me up, and I can hover in one spot like a hummingbird.
Here is a clue. My nose is a vegetable, my buttons are coal, and the sun is my only enemy.
Here is a clue. Four triangles stand guard over a king who's been asleep for thousands of years.
Here is a clue. I wave my four arms all day long, but I never say goodbye. The wind helps me make flour.
Here is a clue. I wear a paper skirt and a fluffy hat, and on your birthday I might hold a candle.
Here is a clue. I'm sweet and cold and I cry when the sun looks at me, so eat me quickly from my crunchy cone.
Here is a clue. I'm round, but you cut me into triangles. I come from Italy wearing cheese.
Here is a clue. My face follows the sun all day, and my seeds are a snack for birds and people.
Here is a clue. I never need a drink and I'm not a fan of hugs. I keep my water hidden in the desert.
Here is a clue. I was a hungry caterpillar before I slept in a little bed of silk. Now I taste with my feet.
Here is a clue. A busy city with thousands of workers, one queen, and walls made of sweet golden hexagons.
Here is a clue. I carry my home everywhere I swim, and I come back to the same beach to lay my eggs.
Here is a clue. I have rows and rows of teeth, I never stop swimming, and my fin says hello above the waves.
Here is a clue. I can turn my head almost all the way round, and I'm wide awake while you're asleep. Who? Who?
Here is a clue. I started life with a tail and no legs, and now I catch flies with my tongue on a lily pad.
Here is a clue. My back wheels are bigger than my front ones, and I'm the strongest worker on the farm.
Here is a clue. I'm red, I'm loud, I carry a ladder and a hose, and I rush to put the hot stuff out.
Here is a clue. I have a neck but no head, six strings but no puppet, and I sing when you strum me.
Here is a clue. I'm a giant orange berry, and in a fairy tale I turned into a carriage.
